title: Offline bootstrap: minimal OCI image set + Terraform variable matrix
content:
Purpose:
This is a working draft that captures a minimal, opinionated set of OCI images and artifact payloads needed to bootstrap a Redwood Private (air-gapped) cluster, plus a suggested Terraform variable matrix and notes for idempotent upgrade flows. The goal is to reduce the first-time bundle size, make offline installation deterministic, and provide an operator-friendly checklist for mirror + restore paths.

Scope and assumptions:
- Target: single-region, air-gapped VPC installation (small production or staging for validation).
- We assume customer provides: isolated VM or bastion with straight-line sneakernet access (USB / tape) or an outbound mirror node with controlled egress.
- We assume inventory of hardware: 3 control-plane nodes, n worker/gpu nodes (variable), on-prem registry host (harbor/registry:2).
- This doc focuses on artifacts required to bootstrap the control plane and core runtime. Model bundles and large weights are handled by downstream bundle process (separate doc).

Minimal OCI image set (opinionated minimal list) - images + suggested fixed tags:
- registry:2 - internal registry for local host (harbor if preferred).
- nginx:1.25.0 - optional ingress for API edge.
- postgres:15.3 - control-plane metadata store (if using postgres option).
- redis:7.2 - caching / kv for control plane coordination.
- redwood/control-plane:v1.8.0 - core control-plane binary image (pin semver).
- redwood/worker-runtime:v1.8.0-cuda - inference runtime image (gpu variant).
- redwood/worker-runtime:v1.8.0-cpu - cpu fallback.
- redwood/sidecar-proxy:v0.7.2 - metrics/tracing sidecar.
- cert-manager/controller:v1.12.0 - local cert issuance (optional).
- kube-proxy/kube-controller images (k8s pinned to 1.28.0) - cluster bootstrap images.

Note: pick exact digests ideally (sha256:...) for highest determinism. The mirroring tool should prefer digests over tags.

Artifact payload layout (tarball recommended):
- /bundle/YYYYMMDD/metadata.json  -> list of artifacts, digests, checksums, and manifest version.
- /bundle/YYYYMMDD/images/<registry-name>/<repo>@sha256:<digest>.tar     -> OCI image tarfiles (skopeo save output).
- /bundle/YYYYMMDD/manifests/manifest-list.json   -> top-level manifest used by mirror tool to seed registry.
- /bundle/YYYYMMDD/terraform/<git-commit>.zip         -> terraform modules and pinned provider binaries if needed.
- /bundle/YYYYMMDD/checksums/SHA256SUMS.txt
- /bundle/YYYYMMDD/signatures/SHA256SUMS.txt.sig   -> optional GPG signature

Mirroring strategy (two operational modes):
1) Local registry push (preferred when registry host has temporary egress or is seeded via sneakernet):
   - On online environment: pull images by digest/tag, re-tag to local-registry/<repo>:<tag>, push to staging registry. Export registry storage (if using registry filesystem) or use `skopeo copy --dest-creds` into a tar bundle.
   - On target: load tar with `skopeo copy dir:/bundle/images docker://local-registry:5000` or `registryctl load`.
2) Tarball-only (no registry on source):
   - `skopeo save` each image to tar, collect into the bundle structure above. On target, use `ctr/nerdctl load` or `docker load` then re-tag and push to local registry.

Commands (examples):
- save image by digest: skopeo copy docker://docker.io/redwood/control-plane@sha256:<digest> dir:./images/redwood-control-plane-<digest>
- load and push locally: skopeo copy dir:./images/redwood-control-plane-<digest> docker://local-registry:5000/redwood/control-plane:<tag>
- verify checksum: sha256sum images/*.tar > SHA256SUMS.txt

Checksum, signing, and verification:
- Enforce 2-stage verification: operator checks SHA256SUMS locally, then validates GPG signature of the sums file. Provide `metadata.json` with artifact list and expected digests.
- Signing: gpg --detach-sign --armor SHA256SUMS.txt -> produce SHA256SUMS.txt.asc. Operators must verify with our key.

Terraform module notes (high level - module: redwood/private-deploy/bootstrap):
- Variables (suggested minimal matrix):
  - local_registry_host (string) - IP:port for registry on target network.
  - local_registry_root_ca (string) - PEM contents or path.
  - control_plane_replicas (number) - 3 default.
  - worker_gpu_count (number) - 0 default (varies).
  - mirror_bundle_path (string) - path on bastion to imported bundle.
  - image_pull_policy (string) - IfAirgap then Always? -> default: IfNotPresent.
- Outputs:
  - bootstrap_manifest (string) - path to deployed manifest.
  - registry_credentials (string) - temporary creds (rotated after bootstrap).
- Implementation notes / gotchas:
  - The module must be idempotent: re-applying with same mirror_bundle_path should not re-create assets or rotate certs unexpectedly. Use lifecycle ignore_changes for certain secrets during upgrade.
  - TF state storage: prefer S3-compatible object store inside airgap (minio). Provide explicit provider alias for providers that need network access; vendored provider binaries should be supported (.terraform/plugins).
  - Provide a `local-exec` hook for `nerdctl load` operations when an operator indicates `use_tarball=true`.
  - Keep TF variable names consistent with customer onboarding sheet to reduce confusion.

Upgrade plan (control-plane + runtime):
- Strategy: two-phase rolling upgrade with canary on a small fleet followed by gradual rollout. If no network, operator provides upgraded bundle and the TF module supports `canary_percent` variable.
- Steps (high-level):
  1) Operator prepares upgraded bundle (images + module zip) and places under /bundle/YYYYMMDD.
  2) Validate checksums and signatures (local verification).
  3) Run `terraform apply -var='mirror_bundle_path=/bundle/YYYYMMDD' -var='canary_percent=10'` to update canary nodes.
  4) Run smoke tests (see validation section). If pass, set canary_percent=50, then 100.
  5) Post-upgrade: run `terraform apply` with `force_restart=false` to avoid unnecessary restarts of long-lived services.
- Rollback: keep previous bundle available on the target registry. TF module should expose a `force_image_override` variable to pin digest to previous sha. Rolling back should only modify image refs and restart pods gracefully.

Validation & smoke tests (simplified list):
- control-plane health: /health endpoints return 200; metrics attached.
- worker runtime: run a minimal inference request against canary worker with a small deterministic prompt; verify tokenization determinism and response sanity.
- registry integrity: pull a random sample image by digest and verify local sha256 matches SHA256SUMS.txt.
- ingress and routing: quick curl through ingress -> traced request appears in control plane traces.

Operator checklist (before giving bundle to customer):
- [ ] metadata.json present and validated.
- [ ] SHA256SUMS.txt and GPG signature created.
- [ ] Terraform zip tested in an isolated ephemeral environment and commit hash recorded.
- [ ] All images included (no missing dependencies listed in manifest).

Sneakernet & special-case notes:
- Very large model weights should be shipped as separate `models/YYYYMMDD/*` tarballs. Keep model manifests separated from bootstrap images to avoid constant re-bundling.
- For customers with awkward media (e.g., tape), create a small verification VM image (qcow2) that contains a single `validate-bundle.sh` script and public GPG key, enabling them to run checks without network.

Open questions / TODOs (priority order):
- Do we want to vendor exact kernel-level GPU drivers in the same bundle? (pros: deterministic; cons: large + licensing).
- Should Terraform vendor providers in the bundle for worried customers? We have a draft PR but need legal sign-off on distribution.
- Decide default retention policy for local registry images (how many days/versions).

References / links (operator bookmarks):
- JIRA: PD-2041 (airgap mirror pipeline)
- GH: github.com/redwood-inference/airgap-sync (PR 67 in linked_artifacts)
- Confluence: AIRGAP-OPERATIONS (internal runbook)

Notes to self (quick scribbles):
- Keep this doc intentionally short — link out to the multi-gig model delivery runbook.
- When we stabilize modules, convert `mirror_bundle_path` into an input file with JSON manifest to avoid ad-hoc scanning in TF.
- Add an example `metadata.json` in the repo for operators to copy.

End of draft.
